messages:
jess_cs: Heads-up — Acadia Health tenant hitting 403 on /v1/generate since last SSO sync. Embeddings still work. Customer is blocked on prod traffic, need quick triage.

acadia_dev: Repro (from their env):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer rk_live_***masked***\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-4o-mini\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Response: 403 {\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\", \"detail\":\"missing scope: inference\"}

provisioner-bot: Provisioner completed SCIM sync for tenant acadia-1002 at 2024-11-03T22:34:12Z. Discovered groups: [\"prod\", \"prod-infer.\", \"prod-embeds\"] -> created svcacct svc-acadia-2024 (scopes assigned: embeddings, rerank)

sam_eng: Looks like the group id had a trailing punctuation (prod-infer.) — our SCIM parser used exact match and dropped that group, so inference scope never mapped. Seen similar with stray punctuation from some IdPs.

marta_auth: Can you paste tenant id + sample masked token + first failure ts? I’ll pull the provisioner logs and auth audit. Also please open a ticket so we can link the fix.

jess_cs: Tenant: acadia-1002. Sample header: Authorization: Bearer rk_live_***masked***. First failure observed: 2024-11-03T22:35:08Z. Incident link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/CINCIDENTS/p-12345 (internal).

sam_eng: Quick mitigation: create a short-lived API key scoped to inference via Console or CLI and give it to the customer while we fix the SCIM normalization. Example CLI: `redwood keys create --tenant acadia-1002 --scopes inference,generation --name temp-infer-fix`

acadia_dev: Confirm CLI syntax? Our infra is terraform'd; prefer non-disruptive path. Will rotation break their jobs?

sam_eng: CLI example (full):
```bash
redwood keys create --tenant acadia-1002 --name 'temp-infer-fix' --scopes inference,generation
# returns: {\"key\":\"rk_live_abc123_temp\"}
```
Rotation won't revoke existing keys, you'll need to update the env var to use the new key for the services that require generation. It's the least invasive short-term fix.

marta_auth: I'm re-running the provisioner now with stricter group normalization (strip punctuation & whitespace) and extra logging. Will post results in ~10m.

provisioner-bot: Provisioner re-run started for acadia-1002 by marta_auth at 2024-11-03T22:45:16Z.

jess_cs: Thanks — pinging customer with the temporary-key workaround and ETA. :thumbsup:

provisioner-bot: Provisioner re-run finished at 2024-11-03T22:47:03Z. svc-acadia-2024 scopes updated: [inference, embeddings, rerank]. Change: group normalization applied (strip punctuation).

acadia_dev: Confirmed from customer side — generate endpoint now succeeds. ✅ Please add normalization to main branch, we hit this on one other tenant too.

sam_eng: Filed PR and ticket: github.com/redwood/provisioner/pull/482 and internal ticket AUTH-7892 — will add unit tests for SCIM group normalization and a regression test. Thanks everyone.
